name: Peach Intelligence
description: Hold a key, speak, let go -- your words get transcribed and pasted wherever your cursor is. The GNOME Shell side of peachOS's Peach Intelligence dictation: grabs the configured push-to-talk key (press to start, release to stop), shows a small recording indicator, and injects the final paste once peachos-dictation-daemon has the text ready. Settings live in the peachOS Settings app's Peach Intelligence tab.
